prompt: I need to design a short quarterly employee engagement pulse survey for a 300-person company. We want to track manager support, workload, and whether people feel safe speaking up, plus one question on whether they're thinking about leaving. Web-based, anonymous. Can you draft the questionnaire and explain your format choices?

assertions.text: Uses item-specific response scales, or explicitly justifies any agree/disagree items chosen
Selects a 5- or 7-point scale and gives a reason tied to the construct/population
Fully labels the scale points with words rather than endpoints-only or numbers-only
Keeps the instrument short and/or explicitly invokes fatigue/length as a reason
Handles the sensitive intent-to-leave and speak-up-safety items with placement and/or confidentiality/anonymity framing
Each drafted item asks about one thing (no double-barreled items spanning the three topics)
Explains at least one format choice in terms of a named bias or the satisficing/cognitive model
